name: Stream Credits
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: End-of-stream credits for your scene: everyone who cheered bits or gifted subs, every channel that raided, and everyone who chatted, each list fading in and out in turn.

settings.label: Leave out of the credits
settings.description: Chatters to skip, like your bots. Separate names with commas.
settings.defaultValue: nightbot, streamelements, streamlabs, moobot, fossabot, sery_bot, wizebot, soundalerts

actions.name: Add a cheer to the Stream Credits
actions.description: Adds the cheerer and their bits to the supporters list. The module's own workflow runs this on every cheer.

fields.description: Supporters in the credits this stream.

actions.name: Add gift subs to the Stream Credits
actions.description: Adds the gifter and their gift subs to the supporters list. The module's own workflow runs this on every gift.

fields.description: Supporters in the credits this stream.

actions.name: Add a raid to the Stream Credits
actions.description: Adds the raiding channel and its viewers to the raiders list. The module's own workflow runs this on every raid.

fields.description: Raiders in the credits this stream.

actions.name: Add chatters to the Stream Credits
actions.description: Adds each chatter the first time they speak, and lets moderators clear the credits with !resetcredits. The module's own workflow runs this on every chat message.

fields.description: Whether this message added a new chatter.

actions.name: Reset the Stream Credits
actions.description: Clears the supporters, raiders and chatters lists.

widgets.name: Stream Credits
widgets.description: Supporters, raiders and chatters, one list at a time, fading in and out on a loop. Long lists scroll like movie credits.

settingsSchema.label: Headline
settingsSchema.description: Shown above every list. Leave empty for none.

settingsSchema.label: Show amounts
settingsSchema.description: Bits, gift subs and raid sizes under each name.

settingsSchema.label: Seconds per list
settingsSchema.description: Long lists stay up longer, until they finish scrolling.
